title: Topological Tricritical Ising Universality Class in One Dimension
abstract: Studies the tricritical point of the 1D O'Brien-Fendley (cluster) model and shows it realizes a topologically nontrivial tricritical Ising (TCI) universality class. The bulk CFT data is the standard c=7/10 minimal model, but the boundary sector is enriched: open boundary conditions reveal a protected twofold degeneracy that splits exponentially (rather than algebraically) with system size, signalling symmetry-enriched topological structure and RG-induced boundary sectors absent from the ordinary TCI fixed point.
key_claims: The 1D O'Brien-Fendley TCI point carries a topologically nontrivial (symmetry-enriched) tricritical Ising universality class.
Open-boundary twofold degeneracy splits EXPONENTIALLY (not algebraically) in L, distinguishing it from the ordinary TCI point.
Bulk CFT data remains standard c=7/10 minimal model; the enrichment is a boundary/topological sector effect.
